    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    steps = max(0, min(abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)) - 1)
    for _ in range(steps):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if abs(tr-r) > abs(tc-c):
        while r + dr != tr:
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        while c + dc != tc:
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
